name: R01: repeated action after completion pays the pot twice
expected: Completed hands reject all betting actions.

name: R02: fold winner cards transmitted to opponent
expected: Fold wins do not expose the winner hole cards.

name: R03: all-in Drawmaha skips drawing
expected: Both players retain their required draw decision.

name: R04: draw deck exhaustion
expected: Legal full-table draws recycle eligible discards without losing cards.

name: R05: duplicate discard indices create a six-card hand
expected: Discard indices must be unique integers and card count must remain five.

name: R06: 2-7 wheel misclassified
expected: Unsuited A2345 is ace-high, not a straight in deuce-to-seven.

name: R07: A-5 pairs/categories misranked
expected: Any one-pair A-5 low beats quads.

name: R08: Stud exposed pair loses first action to ace-high
expected: Pair of deuces acts before unpaired AK in Stud.

name: R09: Razz showing hand orders by lowest rather than highest card
expected: Exposed 23 acts before AK in Razz.

name: R10: Stud chooses an all-in player to act
expected: All-in players receive cards but are skipped for betting.

name: R11: short all-in reopens NL betting
expected: An incomplete raise does not reopen betting for a player who already acted.

name: R12: NaN accepted as a raise
expected: Non-finite and non-number amounts are rejected before mutation.

name: R13: fractional-chip splitting changes total
expected: Pot splitting conserves chips exactly; invalid denominations are rejected.

name: R14: host can replace a live hand
expected: startHand is rejected while the current hand is active.

name: R15: non-chooser can select a DC game
expected: Only the designated chooser can pick, once per choice window.

name: R16: DC breaks when seats are not contiguous
expected: Choice uses stable player identity rather than indexing occupied seats as physical seats.

name: R17: disconnected player stalls later action
expected: Leaving off-turn cannot leave the hand waiting for a departed player.

name: R18: queued target stack can erase winnings
expected: A queued add-on preserves won chips and has explicit top-up semantics.

name: R19: zero-stack players are dealt in
expected: A busted player waits to rebuy and cannot stall forced-bet handling.

name: R20: room destruction leaves controller alive
expected: Destroying a room also destroys its game and timers.

name: R21: reconnect can be claimed using only display name
expected: A rejoin requires a private player/session token.
